assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Reference image: illuminated manuscript page. Create one isolated slender vertical botanical ornament closely matching the little gold-stemmed blue-flowered sprig at the lower left of the reference page. Only the botanical sprig, no page, border or text. Portrait composition, narrow and tall. A delicate sinuous antique-gold stem curves upward from a loose curling base, with a few pointed gold leaves, one small five-petal deep lapis-blue flower near the middle and a second small blue bud. Two tiny gold star glints along the stem. Draw with elegant organic curves, plenty of open transparent negative space. Restrained medieval manuscript gold-leaf painting, fine but readable at 50 CSS pixels wide. Flat hand-painted gilding with subtle ink texture. No vase, frame, straight bar, background, parchment, black fill, bevel or cast shadow. Complete sprig within image with minimal transparent safety margin. Deliver true transparency.

processing: Resize to 256 pixels wide with cwebp, quality 90, alpha quality 100; preserve generated transparency. journal-marginalia.json records the crop that became the blue-flower margin ornament.
